title: Terraria Costs You 19¢ an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Terraria is $9.99 on Steam and takes about 52 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat main story): 19¢ an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (about 205 hours) and it drops to 5¢ an hour, the cheapest hour we've priced yet. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend with 300 hours in Terraria. Its main run costs 19 cents an hour.
